hero.title: Axopar 29 Sun Top
hero.heading: Axopar 29 Sun Top
hero.intro: Developed to push the adventure‑boat genre forward, the Axopar 29 Sun Top was created to meet the real needs of modern boaters seeking smarter usability, higher comfort and purposeful improvements in every detail.

sections.title: More Fuel Efficient
sections.intro: With revamped hydrodynamics, we have increased the fuel efficiency on the 29 by up to 30% compared to the predecessor. That, combined with the larger fuel tank, gives a range of +200 nautical miles.

sections.title: New Innovative Cockpit Layout
sections.intro: Introducing a new optional innovative seating layout that entirely transforms the sociability onboard the 29 Sun Top. This new U sofa configuration, together with a large, foldable hi-lo table, creates a comfortable seating arrangement around the cockpit. The large aft backrest has four different positions that can easily be changed to truly utilize the seating or lounging to the maximum. The hi-lo table also turns into a large sun bed, and with this you can have a second lounging area onboard accompanying the fore deck lounge area, perfect for a day out at anchor.

sections.title: Confident Design Meets Improved Functionality
sections.intro: You can see the Axopar 29 is clearly made with the same Axopar DNA; however, looking closer, the new, bolder, and more adventurous design language and attitude, combined with a wave of new and innovative ideas and fresh solutions, gradually unfold.

sections.title: Welcome to the Hull of Fame
sections.intro:
Every Axopar begins where the boating experience truly begins: below the waterline. Many boaters have learned to accept certain compromises as normal. Our hull-first approach gets the fundamentals right from the start. Since the first Axopar 28 was launched in 2014, this philosophy has shaped our multi-award-winning range, helped create the adventure boating category, and contributed to more than 7,600 Axopar boats being sold worldwide.

Discover the Hull of Fame and the engineering behind the distinctive Axopar driving experience.

items.name: Sun Top Roof
items.title: Sun Top Roof
items.text: Following the very successful Axopar 37 Sun Top with its sliding canvas roof, this feature has now been transferred over to the Axopar 29 Sun Top, to provide sun protection and still having that open air feeling and letting the sun inside the cockpit when you want. The sliding canvas roof is offered standard with manual operation, and optionally with electric actuator.

items.name: Multi-cabin in the Bow
items.title: Multi-cabin in the Bow
items.text:
The multi cabin as standard functions as a large under deck storage area for gear and luggage, to which you can extend an optional fresh water toilet and sink.

The Multi cabin is large enough to transform an optional full-length sleeping cabin for occasional overnighting.

items.name: Driving Experience
items.title: Driving Experience
items.text: Functional, cozy and sociable, the Axopar 29 feels like a sports car, but is also very stable and safe to drive with a proven hull more than capable of handling the rough stuff when needed.

items.name: Snug Cockpit Area
items.title: Snug Cockpit Area
items.text: The curved windshield keeps you protected from the elements, while the lowered floor gives excellent visibility and an improved driving sensation. The repositioned driver and co-driver seats allow for easy access from both port and starboard.

items.name: Safe to Move Around
items.title: Safe to Move Around
items.text: Easy access, and safe boarding of the boat with the integrated steps, in combination with handrails throughout the boat, a step-free walkaround deck area, and strategically placed anti-skid areas on the bulwarks all provide extra safety when moving around the boat.

items.name: Spacious Bathing Platforms
items.title: Spacious Bathing Platforms
items.text: The spacious bathing platforms enable easy boarding, either from a dip in the water or from the dock. When having selected the single-engine configuration, the bathing platforms will be even larger.

items.name: Innovative Layout
items.title: Innovative Layout
items.text: Introducing a new optional innovative seating layout that entirely transforms the sociability onboard the 29 Sun Top. This new U sofa configuration, together with a large, foldable hi-lo table, creates a comfortable seating arrangement around the cockpit. The large aft backrest has four different positions that can easily be changed to truly utilize the seating or lounging to the maximum. The hi-lo table also turns into a large sun bed, and with this you can have a second lounging area onboard accompanying the fore deck lounge area, perfect for a day out at anchor.

items.name: Modular Fore Deck
items.title: Modular Fore Deck
items.text: The new layout on the foredeck provides so much more volume in the bow and you can now seat comfortably up to 8 people. Such is the sense of space that when you're looking forward from the helm you could almost imagine yourself being on the Axopar 37.

items.name: Fridge and Sink
items.title: Fridge and Sink
items.text: To make your home away from home, feel even more like home, you can choose the optional top-loading fridge and sink, so you can have an ice-cool beverage, and some snacks, all while taking in the sceneries.

items.name: Easy Access Remote Switches
items.title: Easy Access Remote Switches
items.text: Conveniently placed beneath the helm, the optional remote main switch enables you to be in and out on the water in a heartbeat.

items.name: Further Improved Aft Cabin
items.title: Further Improved Aft Cabin
items.text: The practical aft-cabin doubles as a huge ‘multi-storage’ space for transporting gear and equipment, and for easy loading there is now a wide-opening hatch so that all kinds of gear, including wakeboards and water skis etc, can be accessed easily and safely stowed from the aft deck.

items.name: Light in the Dark
items.title: Light in the Dark
items.text: The hardtop allows for the addition of a forward-facing 10000+ lumens light bar for low-light conditions. The CCX can also be specified with downward-facing flood lights directed onto the fore and aft decks. Together, these lights form the work lights option.

items.name: Fishbox with Macerator
items.title: Fishbox with Macerator
items.text: Conveniently integrated into the optional bow U-sofa extension, this insulated storage compartment holds up to 74 liters (19 gallons) of bait or catch. The integrated macerator pump and overboard drainage system allow quick flushing and hassle-free water removal, while the insulated construction helps keep temperatures cooler longer on extended trips.

sections.title: Alternatives for Aft Deck
sections.intro: The modular nature of Axopars and our multi-platform approach enable you to customize your boat with an aft layout that suits your everyday needs. As standard, the Axopar 29 Sun Top comes with a spacious open aft deck. The aft deck can also be equipped with an optional Aft Deck Bench, Wet Bar, U-Sofa, or Aft Cabin / Multi Storage Compartment.

items.caption: Add overnight capability with the optional Aft Cabin, offering a comfortable sleeping space for two people. Large windows bring in natural light, creating an inviting retreat for weekend trips and extended cruising.
In true Axopar fashion, the helm on the Axopar 29 Sun Top is driver-focused and provides an uncluttered dashboard, with the essentials within hands reach.
The optional u-sofa layout gives you the option to rearrange the back- and armrests to your liking, giving you more ways to lounge in between exploring.

Upgrade the foredeck into a flexible lounge with the optional U‑sofa. It offers more seating and a comfortable place to relax, with the added possibility to convert the area into a sunbed. An optional foredeck table completes the space, creating a welcoming spot for social moments on the water.

The forward Multi Cabin adds valuable versatility by doubling as extra storage or a comfortable sleeping space. It can be equipped with a freshwater toilet and sink or configured as a full‑length cabin, allowing two adults or a small family to stay overnight with ease.

sections.title: Configurations & Layouts
sections.intro: We want to provide you with an extensively customizable, user-friendly boat that meets your everyday needs year-round and supports all your adventures. The configuration you choose will define the final layout of your boat. Below are a few examples of exterior and interior layouts available.

items.title: BRABUS Line Color Edition
modal_text: For style-conscious customers looking to make their Axopar 29 truly stand out, the Brabus Line Color Edition introduces four striking hull colors: the vibrant, playful Miami Blue; the more subtle, sophisticated Platinum Grey. The fresh, contemporary Glacier Blue; and the timeless, elegant Pearl White. These duo-tone color options combine colored areas with uncolored sections in a standard white finish, giving the boat a dynamic and distinctive look.

items.title: BRABUS Performance Line
modal_text: The BRABUS Performance Line features stylish hull and roof graphics and an extra boost of power on the transom, courtesy of Twin Mercury Verado V8 250hp DTS engines, to get you to your adventure destination promptly.

items.title: The Mediterrana Edition
modal_text:
Designed for those who enjoy lounging, socializing, or cruising in the sun, the Mediterrana Edition enhances onboard comfort and sophistication without compromising functionality. Luxurious features include thicker, plush, more refined cushions in a sophisticated beige tone. The upholstery’s structured texture and patterns not only exude style but also keep lounging areas cool and comfortable, even on the sunniest days.

Elegant bamboo trays and cup holders, along with warm-toned interior finishes, create an inviting, cozy atmosphere. Beige fabric wall panels and bamboo technical panels further enhance the sophisticated look and feel of the lounging areas.

standard_equipment.name: Wheelhouse / Cockpit
standard_equipment.description:
- Seating area with 6 seats in Silvertex Petrol.
- Pilot and co-pilot seats with flip-up bolsters on ​​​rotating and sliding swivels.
- Storage compartment under aft seats.
- Recessed LED roof lights.
- Harbor covers for seats and console.
- Integrated windscreen wipers and washer with separate reservoir.
- Light mast, anchor light & horn on roof.
- Clean helm layout with control switch panel in glass with illuminated buttons.
- USB oultet in helm.
- Steering wheel in leather with Axopar logo.
- Manually opening canvas roof with harbor cover.

standard_equipment.name: General
standard_equipment.description:
- Hand laminated, twin-stepped hull in Vinyl ester resin for the first coat for osmosis prevention.
- Stiffer and more rigid construction compared to previous models
- Reduced weight by optimized glass fiber layup.
- All PVC sandwich material is replaced by PET recycled materials
- No plywood used for constructural purposes.
- Hull design with “sharp entry bow” and integrated engine brackets.
- Sound insulated hull.
- Grey rub rail with rubber end caps
- Axopar 3D signature chrome logo on both sides of hull.
- Bow thruster tunnel preparation.
- Walk-around deck layout with open aft deck
- Anti-skid finishing on self-draining working deck.
- L-sofa bench in bow area with storage space underneath.
- All pulpits, side rails, locks, hinges, filler caps & cockpit grab rails in 316 stainless steel
- 6x cleats around deck.
- LED navigation lights.
- Hooking points for safety harness around side deck areas
- Pulpits on fore deck.
- Anchor box.
- Twin large fender storages on aft deck
- Battery / electrical compartment under aft deck storage.
- Flagpole.
- Fixed 400l fuel tank with level sensor.
- 2x electric auto bilge pumps and 2x manual bilge pumps.

standard_equipment.name: Front Cabin
standard_equipment.description:
- Storage space with skylight and mirror.
- Main fuse panel with automatic fuses.
- 12V USB outlet.
- Fire and CO alarms.
- 2x roof spotlights.
- Ventilation grilles.
